description: Replay two to six caller-owned saved agents as fixed independent capital sleeves. Returns full-period and chronological cold-state holdout equity, attribution, fees, slippage, correlation, covariance, and explicit pass/fail criteria. It does not model shared margin, cross-venue netting, capital reuse, or market impact; the holdout is independently out-of-sample only when the strategies were frozen before inspection. This computation never signs, funds, deploys, changes agents, moves money, or submits orders.

bars.description: Exact aligned historical bars. Defaults to 600.

capital.description: Total hypothetical capital. Every sleeve must receive at least $10.

fee_bps_per_side.description: Execution fee applied to every simulated fill. Defaults to 5 bps.

holdout_fraction.description: Chronological cold-state holdout fraction. Defaults to 0.30.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable retry key. Reuse it after any timeout.

max_holdout_drawdown_pct.description: Optional maximum absolute combined holdout drawdown percentage.

min_holdout_return_pct.description: Optional minimum combined holdout return percentage.

min_holdout_trades.description: Minimum combined holdout trades. Defaults to 1.

sleeves.description: Two to six unique saved agents. Weights must total exactly 10000 bps.

weight_bps.description: Fixed independent capital-sleeve weight in basis points.

slippage_bps_per_side.description: Adverse movement applied to every simulated fill. Defaults to 0 bps.

name: portfolio_backtest
